**Simulation after time 1200:**
- At 1237: T125 (first in queue) starts on M04, followed by T149-T152 on M03.
- At 1263: T153-T154 start on M07.
- At 1278: T128 starts on M04.
- At 1310: T129 starts on M01.
- At 1327: T155-T164 start on M08.
- At 1342: T165 starts on M03.

Therefore, T175 starts on **machine M04**.

Based on the analysis of Cell window 24, I need to determine which waiting task starts first after time 1200.

From the "Queue at window end" section, the waiting tasks in queue order are:
- T112 (priority 4, submitted 520)
- T211 (priority 4, submitted 1041)
- T080 (priority 0, submitted 481)
- T081 (priority 0, submitted 482)
- T118 (priority 0, submitted 603)
- T157 (priority 0, submitted 796)
- ... (T194 and T209 come later)

At time 1202, T146 finishes on M01. The scheduling round considers tasks in queue order:
- T112 (priority 4) needs 3125 CPU and 3180 memory. M01 has free CPU 2188 and free memory 819 after T146 finishes — doesn't fit. T112 gets a reservation for M06 at time 1337.
- T211 (priority 4) needs 6250 CPU — doesn't fit anywhere.
- T080, T081, T118 (all priority 0, need 6250 CPU) — don't fit anywhere.
- T157 (priority 0) needs 1250 CPU and 622 memory. M01 has free CPU 2188 and free memory 819 — T157 fits!

Therefore, T157 is the first waiting task to start, at time 1202 on M01.

T112 starts later at time 1337 (when its reservation is fulfilled), and T194 and T209 are later in the queue, so they start even later.
